usedFor: DitCal holds bookings, and viaSocket utilities hands each one on when “New Booking” runs “Flow in Flow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new booking can start a second workflow that holds the follow-up steps, keeping the first one short.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” needs the ID of the workflow to run, so set it before turning on “New Booking”.
